response.reason: The cited clause, Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 Art. 22(1), establishes the requirement that a quantitative indication (QUID) is required for ingredients that appear in the name of the food, are emphasised, or are essential to characterise the food. The verdict turns on this exact requirement, stating that the product provides the necessary quantitative indications for ingredients named or emphasised. Therefore, the clause supports the verdict.
